component.name: Ruston Mail
component.summary: Unofficial native desktop client for Proton Mail

description.p: Ruston Mail is an unofficial desktop client for Proton Mail, written in Rust. Its three-pane interface lets you read, organize, and send mail without an embedded browser.
It ships with ruston-cli, a command-line client for the same Proton account. Ruston Mail is not affiliated with or endorsed by Proton AG.
